name: MIA PR merge gate
description: Checklist to run before merging a MIA pull request: every check completed and green, none pending, mergeable, and the diff actually read.
content:
Merge gate for MIA pull request #{{pr_number}} in sparesparrow/mia. Run every step. Merge only if all pass. If anything fails, is pending, or cannot be checked, do NOT merge: report which step and why.

## 1. Every check finished and passed
gh pr view {{pr_number}} --repo sparesparrow/mia --json statusCheckRollup --jq '.statusCheckRollup[] | [.name, .status, (.conclusion // "none")] | @tsv'
- Every row must be COMPLETED with SUCCESS (or an explicitly accepted NEUTRAL/SKIPPED).
- Any FAILURE, CANCELLED, TIMED_OUT, ACTION_REQUIRED, or a status other than COMPLETED (QUEUED, IN_PROGRESS, PENDING) is a stop.
- An empty list is a stop, not a pass: it means checks have not started.
- Name each check that failed. A failed "Python Tests" is a stop even when the other checks are green.

## 2. The branch can merge
gh pr view {{pr_number}} --repo sparesparrow/mia --json mergeStateStatus,mergeable,isDraft,reviewDecision
- mergeStateStatus must be CLEAN. BLOCKED, BEHIND, DIRTY, UNSTABLE, HAS_HOOKS and UNKNOWN are stops.
- isDraft must be false. reviewDecision must not be CHANGES_REQUESTED.

## 3. The diff was read
gh pr diff {{pr_number}} --repo sparesparrow/mia
Read it, not just the file list. Confirm:
- The change matches the PR's Claim, and nothing outside the stated slice is included.
- Tests were not weakened, skipped or deleted to get green, and the strings other tests depend on are untouched.
- Each requirement keeps only the evidence that exists (ADR-0010). No bench, hardware or vehicle state is promoted without a record in spec/evidence/<REQ-ID>/.
- Nothing can transmit on a vehicle bus or actuate hardware unless the Safety section says how that is enforced.

## 4. The PR description is complete
Claim / Proof / Not proven / Safety / Next owner are all present, and Not proven is honest.

## 5. Re-check right before merging
Re-run step 1 immediately before the merge command. A push after your first check restarts CI.

## Report
One line per step: PASS or STOP with the reason. Then either "safe to merge" with the exact command, or "do not merge" with what has to change. Never merge on a partial result.
